description: One submitRecordUpdate request signed by a wallet. genesisHash is 0x03 repeated, registry the address of bytes 0x02 repeated, ring of 0x01, validUntilSlot 4242, the signer the Ed25519 keypair of seed 0x07 repeated. The entries set the ring-viewing list on the signer's own record and grant the passkey reader whose P-256 key is the curve generator. wire is the exact JSON text the Rust RecordUpdate::sign and the TypeScript signRecordUpdate write, and updateId the statement hash both verify it under.
